image_description: A close-up view of a polished metal breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a mannequin or stand. The armor features a high-gloss, reflective steel surface with visible vertical ridges and anatomical contouring. It includes shoulder straps and a fauld (waist armor) at the bottom with a central buckle mechanism. The background is a textured, dark blue patterned fabric.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor types.
To analyze the complex reflections and ensure they are physically consistent with a curved metallic surface, checking for AI 'smearing' in highlights.
To verify the sharpness of the metal edges against the background and ensure no melting or fusion artifacts at the boundaries.
To validate the 3D curvature and depth of the ridges and the spatial relationship between the breastplate and the waist armor (fauld).

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the metal surface. In AI-generated images, reflections often warp illogically or fail to match the curvature of the object. Verify if the highlights align with a single light source and if the distorted reflections of the background make geometric sense on the curved steel.
